subject: Mixture IRT fscores and SE calculations

messages.author: 169d33e586f5a9d5
messages.subject: Mixture IRT fscores and SE calculations
parts:
Hi Phil,

Thanks so much for this helpful package. I have a question about fscores when using mixture IRT (e.g., using multipleGroup and dentype = "mixture-4"). 

Using the command "fscores", is the default a weighted EAP score (weighted by the probability of class membership)? Also, how is the SE calculated for the fscores - is it a weighted SE or more complicated?

Thank you,
Shelley

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Mixture IRT fscores and SE calculations
parts:
On Fri, Nov 12, 2021 at 4:13 PM Shelley L. <shelley...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Phil,

Thanks so much for this helpful package. I have a question about fscores when using mixture IRT (e.g., using multipleGroup and dentype = "mixture-4"). 

Using the command "fscores", is the default a weighted EAP score (weighted by the probability of class membership)?
Also, how is the SE calculated for the fscores - is it a weighted SE or more complicated?

No particularly, it's still the posterior standard deviation of the trait estimates, however the information about the SD is treated as a composite as well in the same way (the math to find the EAP is pretty much the same as for the posterior SD that substitutes the EAP estimate into the equation). If you want the posterior classification estimates, you can use method = 'classify'. HTH.

Phil
 

Thank you,
Shelley
